mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital decreases for firms.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals a supply shock that reduces corporate output and increases input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising level of housing starts (HOUST) relative to the previous month indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is higher than the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation that prompts monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery phase (PAYEMS > 150,000 in the past month), rising employment supports consumer spending and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 150,000 in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a deepening economic contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline in the past 5 months.
